description: Source code for FreeType glyph image cache management, including node and family initialization, comparison, and cache operations.

methods.name: FTC_GNode_Init
methods.description: Initializes a glyph node with family and index.

methods.name: FTC_GNode_UnselectFamily
methods.description: Unlinks a glyph node from its family and frees family if no nodes remain.

methods.name: FTC_GNode_Done
methods.description: Finalizes a glyph node, unlinks it from its family.

methods.name: ftc_gnode_compare
methods.description: Compares a glyph node with a query based on family and index.

methods.name: FTC_GNode_Compare
methods.description: Inline comparison of glyph node and query.

methods.name: FTC_Family_Init
methods.description: Initializes a family structure with cache class.

methods.name: ftc_gcache_done
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up a glyph cache.

methods.name: FTC_GCache_New
methods.description: Creates a new glyph cache associated with a manager.

methods.name: FTC_GCache_Lookup
methods.description: Looks up a glyph node in the cache by hash and index, creating or retrieving as needed.
